title.narrative: Improved Public Service Delivery and Enhanced Governance in Rural Uzbekistan

description.narrative: The overall objective of the action is enhanced empowerment of the population, including disadvantaged groups, in all regions of Uzbekistan, particularly in rural areas. The specific objective of the action is improved public service delivery across the country, especially in rural areas.

Update Specific directions of functional analysis are determined and one regulation amended with the support of the projectEvidence Based on the result of the findings of recent analytical reports the following tasks were identified development of analytical materials and proposals on improving national legislation on eGovernment electronic digital signatures public control administrative procedures appeals by individuals and legal entities on the openness of the activities of state authorities and administration as well as other legal acts regulating the powers of state bodies providing public services to individuals and legal entities preparation of proposals on the adoption of a unified special administrative regulations in the field of standardization of practices and procedures for managing the process of providing public services preparation of proposals on the adoption of a model regulation on the application of the Law on Administrative Procedures for civil servants report with proposals on the development of the draft law on the provision of public services.To build an enabling environment for improved public service delivery by streamlining the pertinent regulatory framework and relevant policies as the result of the assessment carried out the Project has identified construction and cadaster services as priority public services as for conducting a FR and BPR.
